limits: Cpanel DEV and whole-MLB DEV were repeatedly exposed (G15 numbers read before, P34/P35 read before this family was designed): a repeated-DEV result, not an independent confirmation
Seeds 0-4 are adoption RNG seeds reused across families (0-2 P24/P25/P27/P29 arms, 3-4 EXP-P30-001 arms); not new data
Bootstrap conditions on fixed predictions (no refit, calibration or selection uncertainty)
MIX_FIT weights and June blend weights are both chosen on the June (blend) rows; that selection is not part of the bootstrap

Pipeline comparison: the CUDA heads train with the epoch cap 60 on CUDA, the G15 flatten heads were fitted with the cap 30 on MPS (configs/EXP-P16-001.yaml); the control MIX_FIXED row (same architecture, same 1/2 mix) measures that pipeline difference directly
A not-confirmed primary documents the ceiling of this direct-head pipeline on the exposed 2025 DEV, not of direct heads in general
Only the prespecified primary can be confirmed; secondary rows are exploratory
No 12-group robustness (R) in this family; no 2026 rows; no policy or service claim

multiplicity.note: one confirmatory test: the prespecified primary, judged on each split with its own unadjusted one-sided p (alpha .05) and confirmed only by intersection-union of both splits; the three secondary rows get Holm across those three per split as a descriptive adjustment and are exploratory; control rows and the unblended head rows have no N

pipeline_difference.note: control at MIX_FIXED is the same flatten architecture and the same 1/2 mix as G15, so it measures the pipeline difference directly: CUDA, epoch cap 60, seeds 0-4 of this family vs the frozen MPS G15 flatten heads fitted with the cap 30 (configs/EXP-P16-001.yaml); descriptive
